audience: clinic managers and front-desk staff at allied-health clinics who use Nookal

useCases.title: List our clinic locations and practitioners
useCases.text: Lists the clinic's locations with address and time zone, and staff and practitioners with title, speciality, locations and whether they can be booked online.

useCases.title: Find open appointment slots
useCases.text: Gets the open appointment slots per date for up to 60 days, for chosen locations, practitioners and a service, with start time and practitioner.

useCases.title: Review our services and class types with price and duration
useCases.text: Lists the appointment types and class types the clinic offers, with category, duration in minutes, price, location and online-booking settings.
